prompt.es: Escribe tu presentación final con dos respuestas matizadas.

answer.text: To sum up my talk, I presented a study of 120 students who slept eight hours a night for a month. Their marks rose from 7.1 to 7.8, and the effect was clear for most of them. Now let me answer your two questions. First, you asked how many of the students were girls. I'm afraid I don't have the exact figure, but as far as I know it was around half, and I would need to check the report. Second, you asked whether these students were simply better students already. That is a fair challenge. To a certain extent you may be right, because the students chose to take part. Nevertheless, the marks of the same students rose during the study, so the findings suggest that sleep may help, although more research is needed. I can give you more detail after the talk. Thank you for your questions.
accepted: To sum up my talk, I presented a study of 120 students who slept eight hours a night for a month. Their marks rose from 7.1 to 7.8, and the effect was clear for most of them. Now let me answer your two questions. First, you asked how many of the students were girls. I'm afraid I don't have the exact figure, but as far as I know it was around half, and I would need to check the report. Second, you asked whether these students were simply better students already. That is a fair challenge. To a certain extent you may be right, because the students chose to take part. Nevertheless, the marks of the same students rose during the study, so the findings suggest that sleep may help, although more research is needed. I can give you more detail after the talk. Thank you for your questions.

Let me summarise the main points of my talk. We studied 120 students for a month. Those who slept eight hours scored higher, and their mark went up from 7.1 to 7.8. Thank you for your two questions. About the first one, how many girls took part, I'm afraid I can't give an accurate number now, but I can check it and send you the figure later. About the second one, it could be argued that these students were already better, and that is a fair point. However, the same students improved during the month, so the results seem to show a real effect. It is likely to be valid for students of our age, although I would not say it is certain. I can give you more detail after the talk.

feedback.es: Una buena respuesta resume la charla con una tendencia y dos cifras, admite con honestidad que no tienes un dato exacto y reconoce la objeción sin perder la conclusión.

origin.text: Caso: acabas de presentar un estudio sobre 120 estudiantes que durmieron ocho horas durante un mes; su nota media subió de 7,1 a 7,8. El público te hace dos preguntas: 1) «¿Cuántas chicas participaron?» (no recuerdas la cifra exacta) y 2) «¿No serían ya mejores estudiantes?». Escribe entre 120 y 180 palabras: un resumen con la tendencia y las cifras, y dos respuestas con matiz.
